definitions.explanation: Tending to act without proper attention or thought, resulting in mistakes. Describes someone who rushes and makes errors due to lack of care.

examples.japanese: そそっかしいので、よく{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}をする。
examples.english: I'm careless, so I often forget things.

examples.japanese: そそっかしい{人|ひと}だから、{確認|かくにん}を{二度|にど}するようにしている。
examples.english: Since I'm scatterbrained, I make sure to check things twice.

examples.japanese: そそっかしく{飛|と}び{出|だ}して、{鍵|かぎ}を{閉|し}め{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I rushed out carelessly and forgot to lock the door.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・そそっかしい → そそっかしくない (negative)
・そそっかしい → そそっかしく (adverbial form)
・そそっかしい → そそっかしかった (past)

NUANCE:
Suggests making mistakes due to rushing or not paying attention, not due to ignorance. Often used self-deprecatingly.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・そそっかしい{人|ひと}/{性格|せいかく} (a careless person/personality)
・そそっかしくて... (being careless, [I]...)

CONTRAST:
・そそっかしい ↔ {慎重|しんちょう} (careless ↔ careful/cautious)
・そそっかしい ↔ {落|お}ち{着|つ}いている (hasty ↔ calm/composed)

RELATED WORDS:
・うっかり (carelessly, inadvertently - adverb)
・{軽率|けいそつ} (rash, thoughtless - more formal)
